title: AYNA healing proposal
description: PROPOSED (#149), not yet agreed or frozen. The top candidates the agent proposes when no element matches a step's target after the smart wait: the step ends as repairProposed and nothing is clicked. The document travels unchanged inside the failing step's result, from the agent (JSON-RPC run.stepResult) or the CLI runner to the server, which stores it for review. Numbers are exact fractions written as strings. See memory-bank/decisions/2026-10-28-healing-proposal-transport.md and docs/agent-rpc.md. Changing it needs an ADR and all three owners' approval (schemas/AGENTS.md).

version.description: Schema version of this document. Each schema release accepts only its own version; bump it on every change.

runId.description: The server's Run id. A CLI run without a server uses a locally generated UUID.

stepIndex.description: Position of the failing step in the run, from 0. With runId, the key of the step result this proposal belongs to.

stepId.description: The failing step's server id; null for a step that was never saved (a CLI run from a file).

logicalName.description: Logical name of the repository object that was not found (the step's target).

appVersionId.description: The server's AppVersion id the run was played against; approving a candidate makes the object resolve to it for this version. Null only in a run without a server.

snapshotId.description: Id of the window snapshot (schemas/snapshot.schema.json, #12) the candidates were taken from. The same step result carries that snapshot; every candidate's elementId is an element of it.

target.description: What the candidates were compared against: the element the repository object resolved to before.

serverElementId.description: The server's Element id (graph Element.id) the target properties came from; null when unknown (no server, or the object has no resolved element).

properties.description: The target's properties exactly as the scorer read them.

scorer.description: Which scorer ranked the candidates and with which weights, so that every contribution can be recomputed.

weights.description: Weight of each scored property. A property not listed has weight 0.

candidatesScored.description: How many candidate elements the scorer ranked; candidates holds the best of them.

candidates.description: The best candidates, at most 3, by score descending and then elementId ascending; rank 1 first. Fewer than 3 when fewer were scored or passed the playback's minimum score (#73).

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: One proposed element with its score and the reasons for it. The contributions add up exactly to score, and each contribution is weight × similarity / (sum of the weights of the compared properties).

elementId.description: The element's id inside the snapshot named by snapshotId (not a server node id).

element.description: The candidate's properties exactly as the scorer read them.

score.description: S = sum of the contributions, in [0, 1].

contributions.description: Each compared property's share of the score, in [0, 1]. The compared properties are the ones the target has; they are the same for every candidate of a proposal.

similarities.description: Each compared property's raw similarity, in [0, 1]; same keys as contributions.

property.description: The properties the scorer compares (SIMILO_WEIGHTS in agent/ayna_agent/heal/scorer.py). location, area and shape are computed from bounds.

exact.description: A non-negative rational number as Python's str(Fraction) writes it: "0", an integer, or "p/q" in lowest terms with q > 1. Lowest terms, and the [0, 1] range of scores, contributions and similarities, are checked by consumers, not by this pattern.

scoredElement.title: Scored element
scoredElement.description: The scorer's input for one element (Element in agent/ayna_agent/heal/scorer.py). A key is left out when the element has no value.

bounds.description: [left, top, right, bottom] in screen pixels.

opaqueId.description: An id the agent makes (snapshot and snapshot element ids, #12); compare it only for equality.

logicalName.description: screen.element in lowerCamelCase ASCII, as in step.schema.json#/$defs/logicalName.

uuid.description: Lower-case UUID, as the server generates node ids; as in step.schema.json#/$defs/uuid.
